about: Curio Class voice bank. Each voice is one Gemini prebuilt voice plus a style, recorded once (scripts/voicebank.py) as a 15-20 s reference; Qwen3-TTS clones it for every tool line (scripts/localvoice.py). A tool picks one with "bank": "<id>" in voice/lines.json. Status: candidate until Cory picks it, then kept.
lines: Good morning, everyone! Today we're going to look closely, ask big questions, and try something new together.
Hmm, that's interesting. What do you notice? Take a moment, then tell the person next to you what you think.
Wow, look at that! You did it. Now let's try one more, a little bit harder this time.
